meta.scope: Migrate ALL 25 edge functions to n8n. Supabase Postgres + Storage buckets REMAIN the system of record; n8n replaces compute/orchestration only.
principles: DB stays on Supabase Postgres. n8n reaches it via the Postgres node (connection string from project DB settings) or supabase-js HTTP. Do NOT migrate tables.
Storage buckets (KB_BUCKET, WA_MEDIA_BUCKET) stay on Supabase Storage, accessed via REST from n8n HTTP Request node.
Every inbound webhook keeps its EXACT existing path so external providers (Meta, Shopify, Google Pub/Sub, Slack, Nitro) need only a host swap, not a re-registration where avoidable.
Signature/HMAC verification that lived in Deno moves into an n8n Code node (Web Crypto API) as the first step after the Webhook trigger.
Function-to-function calls (e.g. wa-webhook -> wa-ai-reply) become n8n Execute Workflow (sub-workflow) calls, not HTTP round-trips.

Synchronous APIs the Next.js app calls inline (wa-send, wa-register, wa-template-create, wa-campaign-send, kb-ingest, shopify-status, shopify-slash) become Webhook + Respond-to-Webhook workflows; the Next.js client base URL flips from the Supabase functions domain to the n8n webhook domain.
open_risks: LATENCY: wa-send is on the hot path for live chat replies. n8n Cloud webhook cold paths add ~100-400ms vs Supabase edge. Acceptable for async, watch for sync UX. Migrate LAST and load-test.

OAUTH REDIRECT: oauth-callback's redirect URI is registered in Google Cloud Console. Moving it requires editing the authorized redirect URI there AND OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI secret. One-time browser re-consent likely needed.
GMAIL PUB/SUB: gmail-webhook receives Google Pub/Sub push. The Pub/Sub subscription push endpoint must be re-pointed to the n8n webhook URL and re-verified (PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN).
META WEBHOOK: wa-webhook verification handshake (hub.challenge) must be reproduced in n8n; Meta App webhook callback URL must be updated and re-verified.
CRON TIMING: exact pg_cron schedules live in the Supabase DB, not the repo. Confirm each schedule from `select * from cron.job` before setting n8n Schedule Triggers.
SECRET SPRAWL: 40+ env secrets become n8n credentials/variables. Group into credential sets to avoid per-workflow duplication.
TOKEN HYGIENE: the n8n MCP bearer token was shared in plaintext and has no exp claim — rotate after cutover.

cutover_plan.strategy: Strangler-fig. Stand up each n8n workflow in parallel with the live edge function, repoint the trigger source, verify, then disable the edge function. Crons first (idempotent, no external re-registration), then webhooks (need provider URL changes), sync APIs last (Next.js client swap + latency).

phases.title: Prove the pattern
phases.why: Cron + WA read + Slack alert + connector_events write touches the full stack with zero external re-registration. Validates credentials + Postgres + Graph from n8n.

phases.title: Order confirmation (already built)
phases.why: Workflows exist. Import, validate node types via MCP, repoint Shopify order-create webhook, run sweep as safety net.

phases.title: WA durable worker + journeys
phases.why: Core WA orchestration. Build WA-Send-Core + Anthropic sub-workflows here; everything downstream reuses them.

phases.title: Inbound webhooks (provider re-point)
phases.why: Each needs the external provider's callback URL changed + re-verified. Do one at a time with rollback ready.

phases.title: Gmail pipeline + OAuth
phases.why: Gmail auth is currently broken (token revoked). Re-bootstrap OAuth through the new n8n oauth-callback in one motion.

phases.title: Remaining sync APIs + admin
phases.why: Lower frequency; swap Next.js base URLs and provider endpoints.

phases.title: Hot-path last
phases.why: Live-chat latency-sensitive. Load-test n8n webhook p95 before flipping the Next.js send proxy. Keep edge function warm as instant fallback for 1 week.

cutover_plan.rollback: Each edge function stays deployed (just unscheduled / un-pointed) until its n8n twin runs clean for 48h. Re-point the provider URL back to Supabase to roll back instantly.
post_cutover: Rotate the n8n MCP bearer token (no exp claim).
Decommission edge functions only after 1 week of green n8n runs.
Move the 40+ secrets out of Supabase function env once nothing references them.
Keep Supabase Postgres + Storage — they remain the data store.

mcp_push.blocker: n8n-mcp added to Claude config + connects, but tools load only after a Claude Code session reload.
mcp_push.after_reload: Discover the n8n MCP toolset (create/update/activate workflow + node validation), then for each workflow: build JSON -> validate node types against live n8n -> create -> activate -> test with a sample event -> repoint provider. No copy-paste.
mcp_push.fallback_if_mcp_management_limited: If the n8n Cloud native MCP server only exposes workflow-execution (not management/CRUD), switch to the n8n public REST API (POST /api/v1/workflows) with an API key, or the community n8n-mcp server which has full node docs + create/update tools.
